title: Note slipped under the study door
text:
Beta,
the study was never locked to you. Only to me.
The numbers are the same ones I forgot that night.
— Papa

title: Shopping list on the fridge, in Mummy's hand
text:
Doodh. Atta. Candles (9!).
Cake from the bakery near the station — chocolate.
Remind him: home by 8. HOME BY 8.
